items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...A pianist, arranger, and composer. Alan Tussaud. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud.

ctx.x: Excuse me. And they began playing very, very experimental music. This was around 1949, maybe 1950. I'm not always so sure on these dates and things, but it's said to be 1949 in the book. They also misspelled the Melvin Lasky's name in the book and called him a clarinetist instead of a cornetist. So I have my doubts about what I read in some books. Anyhow, it was a... They were playing very free avant-garde music. It was also firmly based in the New Orleans tradition. Ed Blackwell, the first drummer in the quartet…
Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud. Alan Tussaud.
